name: Cubical Marching Squares Algorithm
definition: A cubically based approach similar to previous methods, using templates for the faces of 2x2x2 voxel neighborhoods and performing further work to resolve cell ambiguities.
summary: The Cubical Marching Squares Algorithm extracts isosurfaces from 3D scalar fields while preserving sharp features and eliminating inter-cell cracks through Hermite data and 2D face analysis.
